Messages.Author: crispyfloss
Messages.Body:
Does 6.4.2 prohibit two sequential (canceling) maneuvers by the same
minion regardless of the source of the maneuvers?

Specifically, if a minion has a built-in maneuver, can he play a
combat card to go long and then use the built-in to maneuver back to
short? Rules seem unambiguous that he can't, but I'd like to be sure.

Thanks.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Apr 16, 12:48 pm, crispyfloss <crispyfl...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Does 6.4.2 prohibit two sequential (canceling) maneuvers by the same
> minion regardless of the source of the maneuvers?

Yes.

> Specifically, if a minion has a built-in maneuver, can he play a
> combat card to go long and then use the built-in to maneuver back to
> short?  

No.

You cannot cancel your own maneuvers and you cannot cancel your own
press.

LSJ 1998/07/06
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/d0f5e69f56d5b5ef
